impact: pytest emits: 'StarletteDeprecationWarning: Using httpx with starlette.testclient is deprecated; install httpx2 instead.' Will eventually break when the shim is removed. Fix: either upgrade to httpx2 (requires requirements.txt change) or pin a compatible starlette version. Low priority but a known future break.
resolution: Added httpx2 to requirements-dev.txt. Starlette's TestClient auto-detects it and no longer warns. Suite now runs clean: 89 passed, 0 warnings.
title: Starlette TestClient deprecation warning
